admin.dataSources.about.dem: An elevation model as a GeoTIFF with one band, pixels up to 100 m, or a ZIP of Copernicus GLO-90 tiles. It must cover Germany.
admin.dataSources.about.gbif-archive: A GBIF download as a ZIP, DwC-A or SIMPLE_CSV. It gives the occurrences of the years before the API. At least 1,000 fungus records from Germany.
admin.dataSources.about.germany-outline: The outline of Germany as a GeoJSON with polygons. The area must be between 340,000 and 370,000 km².
admin.dataSources.about.model-bundle: A ZIP with bundle.json and the models h0 to h4 for each species. Each species has its own active version.
admin.dataSources.about.site-grid: The site grid as a Parquet file with the column cell and at least the soil pH. Elevation and relief are optional.
admin.dataSources.about.soilgrids: A ZIP of SoilGrids GeoTIFFs. pH, sand and carbon at 0–5 cm are necessary. The service makes the water mask and the soil layers from it.
admin.dataSources.about.static-layers: A ZIP with layers.json and the tiles of the static layers as 256 × 256 grey PNG files.
admin.dataSources.about.tree-scales: The tree shares per scale as a Parquet file with 59 columns. It has as many rows as the tree grid.
admin.dataSources.about.tree-species-map: The tree species map as a GeoTIFF with one byte band, pixels up to 10.5 m, or a ZIP of tiles. The service makes the tree grid, the tree shares and the forest layers from it.
admin.dataSources.about.trees-grid: The tree grid as a Parquet file with 2.0 to 2.6 million cells of 500 m. An active tree species map replaces it.
admin.dataSources.about.weather-checkpoi: A ZIP of the weekly weather Parquet files. With it, the service does not download the closed years.
